title: Generate DO3 crystal structures
action: For each X in Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba, create a DO3 unit cell (space group 225) with F(A), F(B), F(C) and X at Wyckoff coordinates A(0,0,0), B(1/4,1/4,1/4), C(1/2,1/2,1/2), D(3/4,3/4,3/4).
description: Prepare initial crystal structures for all subsequent DFT calculations.

title: Calculate bulk reference energies
action: Using DFT (GGA-PBE, PAW pseudopotentials), compute the total energy per atom of bulk elemental X (Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba) and bulk fluorine in their stable phases.

title: Calculate isolated atom reference energies
action: Compute total energy of isolated X and F atoms in large supercells using the same DFT settings.

title: Determine magnetic ground state and equilibrium lattice constants
action: Perform spin-polarized DFT total-energy calculations for non-magnetic, antiferromagnetic, and ferromagnetic configurations. Compute energy-volume curves. Determine equilibrium lattice constant for the FM phase and confirm FM is the lowest-energy magnetic ordering.
description: Obtain equilibrium lattice constants and total energies of FM and AFM phases.

title: Compute thermodynamic stability and Curie temperature
action: Using the total energy of the FM compound, bulk reference energies, and isolated-atom energies, compute formation energy E_f = E_tot - (E_X_bulk + 3 E_F_bulk) and cohesive energy E_c = E_X_atom + 3 E_F_atom - E_tot. Estimate Curie temperature from the AFM-FM energy difference using the mean-field expression T_C = 2(E_AFM - E_FM) / (3 k_B).
description: Evaluate thermodynamic stability and magnetic ordering temperature.

title: Compute electronic density of states and band structure
action: At the FM equilibrium geometry, perform a spin-polarized SCF calculation with a dense k-point mesh. Compute total and atom-projected DOS and orbital-projected band structure. Extract valence band maximum (VBM), conduction band minimum (CBM) in the spin-up channel, spin-up indirect band gap E_g_up = CBM - VBM, and half-metallic gap E_g_HM = min(|VBM|, |CBM|). Verify a band gap in the spin-up channel while the spin-down channel is metallic.
description: Determine the electronic structure and half-metallic character.

title: Compute magnetic moments
action: Integrate the spin-polarized total DOS up to the Fermi level to obtain numbers of valence electrons per formula unit N_up and N_down. Compute total magnetic moment M_t = N_up - N_down. Extract atomic magnetic moments on F(A), F(B), F(C), and X sites from self-consistent DFT output, and the interstitial moment.
description: Verify integer magnetic moment and site-resolved moments.

title: Compute elastic constants and mechanical properties
action: Apply small strains to the equilibrium FM unit cell and compute resulting energy changes to extract elastic constants C11, C12, C44. Using Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging, calculate bulk modulus B, shear modulus G, Young's modulus E, Poisson's ratio ν, Pugh's ratio K = B/G, and anisotropy factor A = 2 C44/(C11 - C12).
description: Determine mechanical stability and derive engineering moduli.

title: Investigate strain effects on half-metallicity
action: Perform DFT calculations for a range of hydrostatic strains (isotropic lattice changes) and tetragonal strains (varying c/a at fixed volume). At each strain point compute the spin-up band gap and HM gap. Determine the bounds (minimum and maximum strain, or c/a ratio) within which the HM gap remains positive (half-metallicity preserved).
description: Assess robustness of half-metallic state under deformation.

title: Collect and output all calculated properties
action: Gather all computed values from the previous steps and write them into a single JSON file according to the output contract.
description: Structured file containing all required properties for each compound.
output_schema: Top-level object with keys 'BeF3', 'MgF3', 'CaF3', 'SrF3', 'BaF3'. Each value is an object containing numeric fields: a (lattice constant in Å), E_f (formation energy eV/f.u.), E_c (cohesive energy eV/f.u.), T_C (Curie temperature K), M_t (total magnetic moment μB/f.u.), E_g_up (spin-up band gap eV), E_g_HM (half-metallic gap eV), VBM (eV), CBM (eV), M_F_A, M_F_B, M_F_C, M_X (atomic magnetic moments μB/atom), M_int (interstitial moment μB/f.u.), C11, C12, C44 (elastic constants GPa), B (bulk modulus GPa), G (shear modulus GPa), E (Young's modulus GPa), nu (Poisson's ratio), K (Pugh's ratio), A (anisotropy factor), hydrostatic_HM_range (object with min_strain and max_strain in %), tetragonal_HM_range (object with min_c_over_a and max_c_over_a).
